title: "Could not enable FIFO RT scheduling policy" (Operation not permitted) in ros2_control: SYS_NICE, rtprio, non-root users and thread_priority in Docker, measured
excerpt: Why ros2_control_node warns Could not enable FIFO RT scheduling policy in Docker, and which docker run flags fix it: --cap-add SYS_NICE, --ulimit rtprio, non-root users, SYS_ADMIN, thread_priority and --cpu-rt-runtime, measured on Humble, Jazzy and Lyrical without an RT kernel.
